Help Us Fill
*The Truck*
dropOffs: Studio 404, 2285 St. Laurent Blvd, Unit B8b
Stittsville: email us for the address

caption:
It started with one ornament on the antenna. 🎄

Then a few more. Then people started waving, honking and taking pictures everywhere we drove. So we decided to make all that attention count.

This December, our Christmas truck is collecting warm clothing for people experiencing homelessness in Ottawa:

🧥 Jackets and coats
🧣 Toques, scarves, gloves and mittens
🧦 Warm socks, boots, sweaters and hoodies
🛏️ Blankets

Drop-offs: Studio 404, 2285 St. Laurent Blvd, Unit B8b. Stittsville: email us for the address.

Please share this so it reaches more people. Every share helps fill the truck. 🙏
